# Know Your Meme

> > A comprehensive encyclopedia documenting viral internet memes, trends, and online culture across platforms like TikTok, Twitter, Reddit, and YouTube.

Know Your Meme serves as the definitive database for understanding internet culture, providing detailed explanations of viral memes, their origins, spread patterns, and cultural significance. The site covers everything from TikTok dance trends and catchphrases to exploitable image macros and conspiracy theories.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends and viral videos
- Viral meme explanations
- Internet slang and catchphrases
- Exploitable memes and image macros
- Twitter/X viral content
- Reddit meme culture
- YouTube viral phenomena
- Dance memes and challenges
- Nostalgia-based memes
- Pop culture references
- Breaking Bad memes
- Hood movies and 90s nostalgia
- Looksmaxxing culture
- Conspiracy theory memes
- Mental health memes

## Viral Meme Entries

- [Jesse, What the Fuck Are You Talking About | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/jesse-what-the-fuck-are-you-talking-about): Breaking Bad dialogue meme with Walter White & Jesse Pinkman misunderstanding
- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme featuring girl lying over cat, viral on TikTok/Twitter
- [Millennial Burger Place | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/millennial-burger-place): Meme about cliche millennial burger restaurants with 'crazy idea' trope

## TikTok Trends & Dance Memes

- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend based on BunnaB & YKNiece's 'Innit' song catchphrase
- [How About A Nice Big Cup of Shut the Fuck Up | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/how-about-a-nice-big-cup-of-shut-the-fuck-up): WWII poster-based catchphrase meme viral on TikTok with lip-dub trend
